name: RSRC-MVR
flavorText: Ancient skyscraper-sized copper beasts built to haul large amounts of resources across barren wastelands.

name: CK-199 'Woodpecker'
flavorText: Versatile mass-produced tank capable of piercing any armor with its up-to-date railgun.

name: CK-102 'GRÜBBENTRAKTOR'
flavorText: Small lightweight tank destroyer designed to crash and infiltrate enemy bases at lethal speeds.

name: WB-110 'Big Ant'
flavorText: The gigantic backbone of the Disobedient Armed Forces. One of these was enough to change the tides of a battlefield.

name: WB-110 Type 2
flavorText: A new prototype of the beloved 'Big Ant' after many have criticized it for not looking like an ant at all.

name: WB-1 'Bird Walker' ✰
flavorText: An attempt has been made at mass-producing walking machines.

name: CK-101
flavorText: The Disobedient's standard-issue medium tank. Equipped with a cannon powerful enough to plow through anything.

name: Walking Cannon Fortress MK II 'Turtle Lord' ✰
CK-105
flavorText: A light tank designed for reconnaissance missions and carrying infantry.
